assignments.goal: Map Ghost's current wake-recovery path against frozen, resumed, persisted-page, and discarded-document lifecycle cases; produce an implementation-ready deterministic fault matrix and focused specification coverage before production changes.
assignments.rationale: The repository already centralizes visibility/pageshow/focus recovery through recoverAfterWake, but dedicated frozen/discarded lifecycle behavior is not yet certified.
assignments.mandatoryAction: Use repository evidence plus authoritative primary browser/platform sources. Distinguish supported lifecycle signals from assumptions. Add only fixture/specification tests or docs unless a production change is explicitly required by a reproduced contract failure.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory current recoverAfterWake listeners and service rebuild behavior in userscript and generated extension
Define expected behavior for background/foreground, pageshow persisted/BFCache restoration, frozen/resumed execution where observable, and discarded-document restart where detectable
Define RUNNING, PAUSED, and CHOICE-safe recovery outcomes with uncertain-Send fail-closed behavior
Identify deterministic Playwright/Jest injection points that do not add a persistent production debug API
Define exactly-once timer/observer/heartbeat/lock recovery assertions and zero Send actuation assertions
Add a focused specification or failing fixture test when feasible
Cite authoritative primary sources for every browser/platform lifecycle claim
requiredTests: npm test -- --runInBand tests/wake-recovery.test.js or repository-equivalent focused Jest command
run any added focused lifecycle specification test
assignments.fallbackWork: If browser execution is unavailable, produce the deterministic contract and failing/fixture tests with exact commands, then mark submitted or blocked and activate the next dependency-safe assignment.

executionEvidence.result: 2 suites passed; 12 tests passed; 3 explicit TODOs; zero failures

assignments.goal: Obtain exact-branch-head execution evidence for the A1 wake/lifecycle contract tests without changing product behavior.
prohibitedActions: using stale-product-head CI as proof of branch-head tests
acceptanceCriteria: Run tests/wake-recovery.test.js and tests/lifecycle-recovery-contract.test.js on the exact current branch head
Bind evidence to exact commit/run/job IDs or an equivalent direct command result
If a temporary workflow carrier is required, guard the expected head and remove the carrier after execution
On PASS mark both A1 and A1X submitted and activate R4-A2-LIFECYCLE-BUILD
On FAIL preserve the exact failure and activate the smallest correction rather than weakening the test
assignments.fallbackWork: If exact-head execution is still unavailable, retain A1 blocked, document the infrastructure reason precisely, release the lease, and keep this recovery assignment ready for the next execution-capable agent.

assignments.goal: Attempt to falsify lifecycle recovery with repeated suspend/wake, route and lease changes, stale DOM replacement, uncertain Send state, rapid duplicate wake signals, and discarded-document restart semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: Exercise repeated wake signals and prove bounded/idempotent service restarts
Replace relevant DOM before and after wake without stale-node actuation

Inject uncertain prior Send state and prove zero Send actuation
Exercise persisted page restore and discarded-document cases supported by the harness
Record failures and create a bounded recovery assignment rather than masking them
requiredEvidence: CI/job IDs or direct command results
assignments.fallbackWork: If browser execution is blocked, add deterministic adversarial tests and preserve the exact execution gap for R4-A4 without changing production code.
